pull_request.title: Calorimeter: default Si-W ECAL to reusable wedge mothers
pull_request.head: codex/siw-ecal-real-wedges
pull_request.body:
## Summary

- Default LAYOUT-001 to reusable real Si–W wedge mothers for the barrel and both endcaps.
- Preserve the stock replica metadata, readouts, physical leaf geometry and material definitions. Existing compacts without envelopes still use the legacy assembly path.
- Keep the standalone component export default for historical fixtures. Refs #117 and #118, DES-030 and DES-031.

## Validation

- Fresh LAYOUT-001 export and native factory builds passed. All 38 hardware and composition tests passed.
- All 531,936 Geant4 sensor placements and native DD4hep lookups agree with the stock IDs and transforms. All 65 integrated material rays agree.
- The ECAL-only DDG4 map build took 23.0 s on the same Mac Studio where the retained stock map build took 65.9 min.
- The full tracker-plus-ECAL native overlap and transport checks are running. The validation report records the measurement scope and reproduction commands.
